name: Guangzhou TECH-LONG Packaging Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: Publicly listed liquid packaging machinery manufacturer focused on complete-line solutions for beverages and other liquid products.

evidence.claim: Company states it was established in 1998 and provides full-line liquid packaging solutions.
Official site lists integrated filling lines, blow molding machines and labeling machines.

name: Jiangsu Newamstar Packaging Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: Listed Chinese supplier of intelligent-factory integration solutions for liquid products, including blow-fill-cap and aseptic filling systems.

evidence.claim: Official site describes the company as a listed provider of integrated intelligent-factory solutions for liquid products.
Official site lists aseptic blow-fill-cap and blow-label-fill-cap integrated equipment.

name: Soontrue Machinery
summary: Packaging machinery group with multiple manufacturing bases and products spanning flow wrapping, VFFS, pouch packaging, cartoning and end-of-line automation.

evidence.claim: Official site states four manufacturing bases and lists flow packaging, vertical packaging, premade pouch, cartoning and robotic end-of-line products.
Company history page states Soontrue was founded in 1993.

name: Hualian Machinery Group
summary: Packaging machinery manufacturer focused on end-of-line and general packaging equipment, including sealing, vacuum packaging, strapping and shrink systems.

evidence.claim: Official site identifies Hualian as a packaging machine manufacturer and lists vacuum, sealing, shrink, carton sealing, strapping, horizontal and vertical packaging categories.
Official site states packaging machinery is used in food, beverage, daily chemicals, logistics/e-commerce, pharmaceuticals and other industries.

name: Shanghai Grepack Packing Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: Intelligent packaging equipment manufacturer offering bottling, filling, labeling, carton packing and palletizing systems.

evidence.claim: Official site states Grepack was founded in 2002 and integrates R&D and production of intelligent packaging equipment.
Official site lists bottling production lines including filling, capping, labeling, case packing and palletizing.

name: Shanghai Acepack Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Packaging equipment manufacturer specializing in flexible packaging, doypack, sachet and premade-pouch systems.

evidence.claim: Official site states Acepack was established in 2005 and develops and manufactures intelligent packaging systems and automatic packaging equipment.
Official site lists doypack, sachet and premade bag packaging machines.

name: Hangzhou Youngsun Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd.
summary: Packaging equipment manufacturer with a broad portfolio covering labeling, case handling, strapping, palletizing, wrapping and packaging lines.

evidence.claim: Official site lists labeling, case erecting/packing/sealing, strapping, palletizing, wrapping and customized packing production lines.
Industry directory profile states the company was built in 1983 and is a listed packaging equipment manufacturer.

name: Zhejiang Dingye Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: Wenzhou-based packaging machinery supplier with public product and contact information; profile kept conservative pending deeper evidence review.

evidence.claim: Official site identifies Zhejiang Dingye Machinery Co., Ltd. and publishes its Wenzhou manufacturing/contact address.
